content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: A development of 4 private promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a complete all-trades package (TCE) including roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project integrates structural concrete works, interior finishes, and dedicated site access infrastructure within a compact residential footprint.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the entire scope of works, managing the structural reinforced-concrete framing, masonry, internal and external finishes, and MEP installations. The civil engineering phase encompassed the complete installation of roads and utility networks (VRD) to ensure independent service connections.

The architectural massing features clean contemporary volumes, recessed glazing, and integrated pergolas. Site constraints were addressed through coordinated circulation planning, separating pedestrian paths from vehicular access points.
content.authority: A residential delivery demonstrating precise structural execution, facade articulation, and integrated utility infrastructure from ground works to final handover.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Rouiba promotional villas project?
faq.answer: The project comprises 4 private promotional villas in Rouiba, delivered with complete structural, finishing, and civil works.

faq.question: Which construction phases were managed by the contractor?
faq.answer: The works were executed as a complete all-trades delivery (TCE), covering reinforced-concrete framing, interior and exterior finishes, MEP, and roads and utility networks (VRD).

faq.question: How are the site utilities and access configured?
faq.answer: The site layout incorporates dedicated pedestrian and vehicular circulation, supported by fully integrated utility connections and surface drainage networks.
